offensive.name: Chain Spark
offensive.description: Your lightning leaps from one victim to the next.

tiers.text: Dexterity save; arcs originate from one affected creature of your choice and cannot leap to creatures already affected this casting. The effect deals +1 die of lightning damage, and one arc leaps to a creature within 15 feet of the original target — it takes half the effect's damage on a failed save.
tiers.card: +1 die · one arc to a creature within 15 ft (half damage on a fail)

tiers.text: Bonus damage increases to +2 dice. Arcs leap to 2 creatures within 15 feet — each takes full damage on a failed save, half on a success.
tiers.card: +2 dice · arcs to 2 within 15 ft, full on a fail, half on a success

tiers.text: Bonus damage increases to +3 dice. Arcs leap to 3 creatures within 20 feet. Creatures wearing metal armor or made of metal have disadvantage on the save.
tiers.card: +3 dice · arcs to 3 within 20 ft · metal armour saves at disadvantage

tiers.text: Trigger a Chainstorm — lightning arcs to all creatures within 30 feet of the arcs' origin creature. Each must make a Dexterity save or take full damage and be Stunned until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Chainstorm — arcs to everyone within 30 ft of the origin · fail = full damage + Stunned

offensive.name: Thunderbreak
offensive.description: Your lightning doesn't just shock — it shatters.

tiers.text: Strength save (in addition to the Composition's saving throw, if any). The effect deals +1d8 thunder damage, and targets hit must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked back 10 feet.
tiers.card: +1d8 thunder · Str save or knocked back 10 ft

tiers.text: Bonus damage increases to +2d8. Knockback increases to 20 feet, and failed saves also impose disadvantage on Concentration checks until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: +2d8 · knockback 20 ft · disadvantage on Concentration until end of their next turn

penalty.disadvantage: Concentration checks until the end of their next t

tiers.text: Bonus damage increases to +3d8, and nearby objects or barriers within 5 feet must make a Dexterity save or shatter.
tiers.card: +3d8 · objects and barriers within 5 ft save or shatter

tiers.text: Thunderbreak becomes a concussive burst — all creatures within 20 feet of the original target must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone, pushed 30 feet, and Deafened for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Concussive burst — everyone within 20 ft: prone, pushed 30 ft, Deafened 1 min

offensive.name: Flash Precision
offensive.description: Lightning always hits first — it doesn't miss, it decides.

tiers.text: You may reroll one attack roll or saving throw associated with this effect, taking the new result.
tiers.card: Reroll one attack or save tied to this effect

tiers.text: Your lightning effects ignore cover and cannot have disadvantage imposed on their attack rolls.
tiers.card: Your lightning ignores cover and can't be given disadvantage

tiers.text: Once per effect, you may automatically hit with one lightning-based attack or spell — no roll required.
tiers.card: Once per effect, one lightning attack just hits — no roll

tiers.text: Designate one creature within 120 feet — it is struck by a Sky Bolt with no attack roll, making a Dexterity save at disadvantage against your Verum DC and taking 12d12 lightning damage on a failure (half on success). On a failure it also cannot use reactions until the end of its next turn and immediately drops Concentration if applicable.
tiers.card: Sky Bolt: 12d12 lightning at 120 ft, Dex save at disadvantage (half on success), no reactions, drops Concentration

supportive.name: Voltstride
supportive.description: You move as fast as thought.

tiers.text: When casting the effect, you may teleport up to 10 feet as part of the same action.
tiers.card: Teleport 10 ft as part of the cast

tiers.text: Teleport range increases to 30 feet, and you gain advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the start of your next turn.
tiers.card: Teleport 30 ft · advantage on your next Dex save

buff.advantage: the next Dexterity saving throw you make before th

tiers.text: You may teleport before or after the effect resolves, and you ignore opportunity attacks during this movement.
tiers.card: Teleport before or after it resolves · no opportunity attacks

tiers.text: For 1 minute, you may divide yourself into afterimages — gaining +5 AC against one attack per turn, and teleporting up to 60 feet as a reaction whenever you are targeted by an attack or spell.
tiers.card: 1 min of afterimages — +5 AC vs one attack per turn, teleport 60 ft as a reaction when targeted

control.name: Conductive Charge
control.description: You leave behind a charge that's waiting to explode.

tiers.text: Dexterity save. A creature that fails becomes Charged for the Composition's condition duration or until triggered. The next time it takes damage, it takes an extra 1d6 + your Verum Modifier lightning damage.
tiers.card: Fail = Charged · next damage it takes adds 1d6+VM lightning

tiers.text: Detonation increases to 2d6 + your Verum Modifier. Charged creatures glow faintly, cannot benefit from invisibility, and have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
tiers.card: 2d6+VM · Charged creatures glow, lose invisibility, disadvantage on Dex saves

tiers.text: Detonation increases to 3d6 + your Verum Modifier. The charge jumps — if the Charged creature is within 10 feet of another creature when it takes damage, that creature also takes the bonus lightning damage.
tiers.card: 3d6+VM · the charge jumps to a creature within 10 ft when it detonates

tiers.text: Charged targets become highly unstable — if they die while Charged, they explode, dealing 6d10 lightning damage in a 20-foot radius (Dexterity save halves).
tiers.card: Die while Charged and they explode — 6d10 lightning in 20 ft (Dex half)

creation.name: Stormforged
creation.description: Nothing you make from lightning ever holds still.

tiers.text: Your creations crackle. A creature that touches or strikes a Structure, or is hit by a Construct or an Object you made, takes 1d6 lightning damage. Constructs gain +10 feet of speed.
tiers.card: Creations crackle · 1d6 lightning to touch or be hit · Constructs +10 ft speed

tiers.text: Your creations are immune to lightning damage. A creature hit by a Construct must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or lose its reaction until the start of its next turn.
tiers.card: Immune to lightning · hit by a Construct = Dex save or lose your reaction

tiers.text: Structures conduct — a creature wearing metal armor that starts its turn within 5 feet of one takes 2d6 lightning damage. Constructs may teleport up to 30 feet as a bonus action.
tiers.card: Metal armour within 5 ft of a Structure takes 2d6 · Constructs teleport 30 ft as a bonus action

tiers.text: Constructs are living storms: once per turn, their attack arcs to one creature within 15 feet of the target for half damage. A destroyed Structure or Construct discharges for 6d10 lightning damage in a 20-foot radius (Dexterity save for half).
tiers.card: Constructs arc to a second creature within 15 ft · destroyed creation discharges 6d10 in 20 ft (Dex half)

utility.name: Quicksilver Current
utility.description: The message and the messenger are the same spark.

tiers.text: Send a message of up to 25 words as a spark to a creature you know within 1 mile — it arrives instantly. Power or overload a small mechanism. Sense electrical currents and gathering storms within 300 feet.
tiers.card: 25-word spark message within 1 mile · power or overload a mechanism · sense currents and storms 300 ft

tiers.text: Quicken a group — you and allies within 30 feet gain +10 feet of speed and advantage on initiative for 1 hour. Read the sky to know the weather for the next 24 hours.
tiers.card: You and allies within 30 ft: +10 ft speed and advantage on initiative for 1 hr · read tomorrow's weather

tiers.text: Ride the bolt — you and up to three willing creatures travel as lightning to any point you can see within 1 mile, arriving instantly. Disable a nonmagical mechanism or construct by touch.
tiers.card: Ride the bolt — you and 3 others travel as lightning to any point you can see within 1 mile

tiers.text: Call or still a storm over a region up to 1 mile across for 1 hour, or send a single spark-message to every creature you know within 100 miles.
tiers.card: Call or still a storm over a mile for an hour · or spark-message everyone you know within 100 miles

complementEffects.name: Overclock
complementEffects.description: The voltage doesn't just hurt — it scrambles.

effect.text: On a hit or failed save against the primary effect, the target must succeed on a Dexterity save against your Verum DC or act last in the initiative order on their next turn, regardless of their initiative roll.
effect.card: Fail: acts last on its next turn whatever its initiative

upgrades.text: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target also cannot take reactions until the start of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Also no reactions until the start of its next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail also have disadvantage on the first attack roll or saving throw they make on their next turn.
upgrades.card: Also disadvantage on its first attack or save next turn

penalty.disadvantage: the first attack roll or saving throw they make on

complementEffects.name: Static Field
complementEffects.description: Your charge bleeds outward, sharpening everything around you.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, you generate a Static Field for 1 minute — allies within 15 feet gain +2 to initiative rolls and cannot be surprised while within range.
effect.card: 1 min: allies within 15 ft get +2 initiative and can't be surprised

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Allies within the field also gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws while it is active.
upgrades.card: Allies in the field also get advantage on Dex saves

buff.advantage: Dexterity saving throws while it is active

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The radius increases to 30 feet, and allies within it may use their reaction to move up to 10 feet when they would otherwise be hit by an attack.
upgrades.card: Radius 30 ft · allies may react to move 10 ft when they'd be hit

complementEffects.name: Groundstrike
complementEffects.description: The bolt pins them to the earth.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their save, that target must succeed on a Dexterity save against your Verum DC or be unable to teleport, use movement-based abilities, or take the Dash action until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Fail: no teleport, no movement abilities, no Dash until end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target also cannot take reactions and has its movement speed reduced by 15 feet until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Also no reactions and −15 ft speed

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail are additionally knocked prone, and standing up costs them their full movement rather than half.
upgrades.card: Also knocked prone · standing up costs their full movement
